# Kettle Moraine Professional Cleaners

> Professional carpet, upholstery, tile, LVT, and hard surface floor cleaning serving Washington County and southeastern Wisconsin since 1987. IICRC-certified, family-owned, West Bend, WI.

Kettle Moraine Professional Cleaners (KMPC) is a family-owned cleaning company based in West Bend, Wisconsin. Founded in 1987, the company provides residential and commercial floor and upholstery cleaning services throughout Washington County, Ozaukee County, and the greater Milwaukee area.

## Services

- **Carpet & Upholstery Cleaning**: Hot water extraction and low-moisture cleaning for residential and commercial carpets, upholstered furniture, and area rugs. IICRC-certified 8-step process. Optional 3M Scotchgard fabric protection. <https://kmpc.netlify.app/services/carpet-upholstery-cleaning>

- **LVT, Tile & Hard Surface Cleaning**: Professional cleaning for luxury vinyl tile (LVT), luxury vinyl plank (LVP), ceramic and porcelain tile, hardwood, engineered wood, laminate, natural stone (marble, granite, terrazzo), and VCT floors. Manufacturer-safe methods, grout sealing available. <https://kmpc.netlify.app/services/lvt-tile-hard-surfaces>

- **Commercial Carpet & Hard Floor Programs**: Customized maintenance and restorative cleaning programs for offices, retail, healthcare, hospitality, and property management. Includes construction clean-up and indoor air quality optimization. Flexible scheduling around business hours. <https://kmpc.netlify.app/services/commercial-programs>

## About

IICRC-certified technicians with 30+ years of experience in the cleaning industry. Serving West Bend, Menomonee Falls, Germantown, Slinger, Hartford, and surrounding communities. <https://kmpc.netlify.app/about>

## Service Area

Washington County, Ozaukee County, and greater Milwaukee area, Wisconsin. Cities served include West Bend, Menomonee Falls, Germantown, Slinger, Hartford, Cedarburg, and surrounding communities.
